text: APPROVE. The extracted `Run`, `LexString`, `LexRawString` and `FindStringEnd` keep the original control flow, so behaviour is unchanged. By my hand count `FindStringEnd` is about 14 and the other methods are lower, all within the threshold of 15. The primary-constructor parameters are only used in initializers as expressions (`text.ToCharArray()`, `text.Length`) rather than assigned directly to a field, so CS9124 should not fire under warnings-as-errors. I have not built the project, so the build condition rests on that reading.
